audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart said 'Skill' on rows 1-4 and first-item/2+ while content win[] and the packet both say Karma levels 1-5, Sylas from 6 on.
audit.why: Karma has Mantra at level 1 (R text: 'Mantra is available at level 1') and out-ranges Sylas 950 vs 775; Sylas flips it at 6 by stealing Mantra or a better ult.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to Karma (rows 1-4) and Sylas (first item, 2+ items); whys rewritten to match.

audit.why: Spikes: Karma level 1 (Mantra) and short-trade windows 3-5; Sylas 6 (Hijack), first item + Kingslayer dive, outscales late. Content spikes[] covers all four.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; dosFull[1].t invented a 'post-combo silence' Karma does not have; widespread misgendering; copy-paste bleed in dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d.
audit.why: Karma W Focused Resolve is 12s flat, R Mantra 40s at rank 1 (reduced by her damaging abilities); her W root punishes Abscond and E Inspire shields the burst. No silence anywhere in her kit.
audit.corrected: Numbers added, silence removed, pronouns fixed, bleed bodies rewritten to match their titles.

notes: Chart: content win[] and packet already agreed (Karma 1-5, Sylas 6 on); only full-layer sides moved, so side-only edits per the chart rule — whys for the moved rows 1-4 rewritten to match the Karma verdict, phases 5-6 whys already described Sylas winning. dosFull[1].t claimed a 'post-combo silence' — Karma has no silence in her kit; replaced with a tether-whiff window.
